title: Weak-type characterizations of Sobolev and bounded variation spaces on metric measure spaces
summary: Given a complete doubling metric measure space $(X,ρ,μ)$ supporting a Poincaré inequality, we prove weak-type characterizations of the Sobolev space $\dot{W}^{1,p}(μ)$ and the space of functions of bounded variation, achieving a full analogy in general Poincaré spaces with the Euclidean results of Brezis et al. [Anal. PDE 17 (2024), 943-979]. The main novelty is that the finiteness of a weak-type norm, which only refers to differences or mean oscillations of $f$ without assuming any smoothness a priori, already guarantees the membership of $f$ in the relevant Sobolev or BV space.
